user.title: Connect to grottserver
user.description: Use the grottserver HTTP API, usually port 5782. This is not the MQTT feed.

manual.title: Inverter serial
manual.description: grottserver at {host} did not list an inverter. Enter the serial if you still want the entry.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach grottserver. Check the host and port 5782.

init.title: Grott register options
init.description: Each refresh reads the registers one at a time, so keep the interval at 15 minutes or slower. Slots 4-6 are extra SPH registers and are not on every inverter.

read_register.name: Read register
read_register.description: Read one inverter or datalogger register from grottserver.

format.name: Format
format.description: hex, dec, or text. Inverter reads default to hex. Datalogger reads default to text.

inverter_id.name: Inverter serial
inverter_id.description: Required only when more than one inverter is configured.

write_register.name: Write register
write_register.description: Write one register that is not part of a time slot. Slot times must use Write slot.

value.name: Value
value.description: Decimal by default. Use the format field for hex or text.

inverter_id.name: Inverter serial
inverter_id.description: Required only when more than one inverter is configured.

write_slot.name: Write schedule slot
write_slot.description: Set a battery-first or grid-first window. Start, stop, and enable are sent together.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: 1 to 3, or 4 to 6 on inverters that have the extra block.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn this window on or off.

inverter_id.name: Inverter serial
inverter_id.description: Required only when more than one inverter is configured.

write_registers.name: Write registers
write_registers.description: Write a contiguous run of inverter registers as concatenated 16-bit hex words.

value.name: Hex value
value.description: Four hex digits per register, concatenated.

inverter_id.description: Required only when more than one inverter is configured.
